The '''Stuffed AT-AT Toy''' was a stuffed, patchwork toy version of the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] walker used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|army]].

==Behind the scenes==
The stuffed AT-AT toy was a reward for players of the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' who opted-in for e-mail newsletters from [[Sony]] Online Entertainment. It was part of the [[:w:c:swg:Email Collection System|Email Collection System's]] [[:w:c:swg:Third Delivery|Third Delivery collection]]. Players could either use it to decorate their virtual homes or consume it to complete the [[:w:c:swg:Collection|collection]].
